It also minimizes microplastic and nanoplastic release during end-of-life grinding and processing (parameter p, Page 80) compared to composite materials, which are highly detrimental to material recovery (parameter e, Page 79).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage (which may prefer ABS/PC for superior mechanical strength, flame retardancy, and surface finish) and Use stage (which values durability and impact resistance during operation).

It ensures easy non-destructive disassembly, which directly supports the ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing, and refurbishment (parameter c, Page 79; definitions on Page 27) and improves the quality of recycling by allowing clean material separation (parameter d, Page 79).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage (which prefers automated adhesive bonding or welding to reduce assembly time and production costs) and Use stage (which may require tighter seals to prevent dust/air leakage).

options_evaluated: Brushless DC motor with modular, extractable magnets
Brushed DC motor with glued permanent magnets
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC motor with modular, extractable magnets
assessments.rationale: A modular design allows the motor to be easily disassembled, facilitating refurbishment, remanufacturing, or reuse of the motor assembly (parameter c, Page 79; definitions on Page 27). It also avoids gluing magnets, which is a technical solution detrimental to recycling and material recovery (parameter e, Page 79), thereby enhancing the ease and quality of recycling of critical raw materials (parameter d, Page 79).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage (higher initial component cost and complexity of sourcing modular brushless motors) and Use stage (potential slight increase in initial purchase price).

options_evaluated: Removable aluminum heat sinks with dry thermal pads
Overmolded heat sinks with permanent thermal paste
Liquid cooling loop with glycol coolant
assessments.recommendation: Removable aluminum heat sinks with dry thermal pads
assessments.rationale: Dry thermal pads are easily separated from the heat sink and electronic components, avoiding solutions detrimental to recycling (parameter e, Page 79). This design prevents contamination of the aluminum and PCB fractions, improving the ease and quality of recycling (parameter d, Page 79) and reducing the amounts of hazardous waste generated during end-of-life treatment (parameter r, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (which may prefer thermal paste or liquid cooling for superior thermal dissipation and higher motor efficiency during high-load operations).

options_evaluated: Modular component cassettes (separate motor, cord reel, and PCB modules)
Semi-modular architecture with soldered wire connections
assessments.recommendation: Modular component cassettes (separate motor, cord reel, and PCB modules)
assessments.rationale: Modular cassettes allow individual modules to be easily accessed, repaired, or upgraded, directly supporting ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing, and refurbishment (parameter c, Page 79; definitions on Page 27). This architecture also reduces the amounts of waste generated in end-of-life treatment (parameter r, Page 80) by allowing functional modules to be salvaged and reused instead of discarding the entire appliance.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage (increased material consumption and higher assembly complexity for separate cassette housings, potentially increasing the initial material footprint).

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized Li-ion battery pack
assessments.rationale: Eliminating the battery entirely avoids the generation of hazardous battery waste at end-of-life (parameter r, Page 80) and significantly reduces the environmental footprint produced in end-of-life treatment (parameter m, Page 80). It also eliminates the need for energy-intensive battery recycling processes (parameter g, Page 79) and avoids technical solutions that are highly detrimental to simple recycling streams (parameter e, Page 79).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (which strongly prefers cordless battery-powered models for portability, ease of use, and convenience).
